text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Israeli newspapers on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Internal security minister Kahalani on Bar-On affair: Prime Minister Netanyahu must resign if involved.
- Netanyahu to meet Jordan's King Hussein today.
- Palestinian Authority, Jordan warn against Har Homa.
- British angry over German paper's 'Jew' tag.
- Netanyahu to be investigated again by police in Bar-On appointment affair.
- Israel in past rejected American request to send U.S. engineer Tanenbaum for training at military development institute.
- Eleven Palestinians missing after car swept away by flood near Qalqilya.
- Housing ministry survey: Arab majority in north by 2020.
- Israel secretly brought naturual gas from Sinai before 1981 withdrawal.
- Storm in political establishment after investigation of Netanyahu.
- Netanyahu expected to be interrogated under warning a second time.
